Description: IACSD - One of the best Authorized Training Centres of CDAC ACTS for PG Certificate Programme Courses.Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) is the premier R&D organization of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) for carrying out R&D in IT, Electronics and associated areas. Different areas of C-DAC, had originated at different times, many of which came out as opportunities.

C-DAC's Advanced Computing Training School (ACTS) is the premier training arm of the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC). Established to create high-quality manpower in the field of Information Technology, ACTS offers various Post Graduate Diploma and Certificate courses.Over the years, CDAC ACTS has trained thousands.
